label: The step-by-step guide to the Guide Me Builder: every step, spotlight, narration and picture

params.name: lede
params.default: Turn a Guide Me script into a live tour you can preview and hand to any site. Here is the whole road, from import to export.
params.label: The cover's opening line; {product} = this edition's name

params.name: icon
params.label: The emblem on the cover (an icon name)

default.title: Your Guide Me builds
default.say: Every tour you create lives here, with its site, its page, how many steps it has and when it last changed. Search finds one by title, site or page.

default.title: Bring a script
default.say: Drop or choose a Guide Me script file, or paste the script into the box. A script names its site and page, then the steps: what each one spotlights and what it says.

default.title: Create Guide Me
default.say: Press Create Guide Me. Every rule is checked at once and anything to fix is listed in plain words; nothing is saved until the script is clean.

default.title: About this tour
default.say: An open build shows its site, its page, its title and its opening line, so you always know which page this tour belongs to.

default.title: The steps
default.say: Each row is one card of the tour: its title, its narration, the part it spotlights, anything it opens first, and its picture.

default.title: Preview
default.say: Preview plays the tour right here, card by card, with Listen for the browser's own voice. The parts it points at live on its own site, so here each card sits in the middle.

default.title: Export
default.say: Export downloads one zip with everything a page needs: the kit, the script, a ready Guide me button and a read-me. Any site can use it; our own portals import the script in How to Use instead.

default.title: Replace script
default.say: Replace script brings a newer version into the same build. It passes the same checks first, so a build always holds a tour that works.

description_nl: 2026-09-28: the Guide Me Builder's own tour (skill screen-tour-guide). Step 1 targets the list only and opens it with All builds; the first step inside a build opens the first build.
